results.title: Ampem Darkoa Ladies qualify for 2026 CAF Women’s Champions League after beating Edo Queens
results.description: Ampem Darkoa Ladies have secured qualification for the 2026 CAF Women’s Champions League after defeating Nigeria’s Edo Queens 1-0 in the continuation of the WAFU Zone B qualifying final. The Ghanaian champions sealed their place in Africa’s premier women’s club competition following the resumption of the disputed fixture, which was originally played on September 5, 2026. The match was continued after the Confederation of African Football (CAF) Appeal Board dismissed Edo Queens’ challenge against the Organising Committee’s decision of September 26, bringing an end to the prolonged qualification dispute.CAF upheld the original ruling but directed that new match officials be appointed to oversee the continuation of the fixture. All other sporting conditions remained unchanged, while the Nigerian side’s remaining claims and requests were rejected. With the ruling clearing the way for the match to continue, Ampem Darkoa took full advantage of the opportunity, securing a crucial 1-0 victory to confirm their qualification for the continental tournament. The result represents a significant achievement for the Ghanaian side, who have established themselves as one of the country’s leading forces in women’s football.
